item.name: distortion-image
item.summary: media: WebGL2 hover-displacement image overlay (webgl, client-only, ~3.8 KB, reduced motion -> static image, mobile -> plain image / 0 contexts)

useWhen: Portfolio galleries and editorial features requiring tactile pointer distortion
Product showcases where fine-pointer interaction reveals optical depth
Media elements benefiting from fluid ripple displacement over real images
avoidWhen: Long lists of small thumbnails on mobile where static images are optimal
High-frequency rapid scrolling feeds without user hovering
Images lacking CORS headers when hosted on cross-origin domains

alternatives.name: noise-field
alternatives.when: When a generative ambient canvas background is needed instead of image distortion

tiers.0: Plain static image with 0 WebGL contexts and zero animation overhead
tiers.1: Plain static image for coarse touch pointers with zero context allocation
tiers.2: WebGL2 displacement overlay at DPR <= 1.5 and texture cap <= 1024px
tiers.3: Full WebGL2 displacement overlay at DPR <= 2.0 and texture cap <= 2048px

reducedMotion.description: Renders plain static image with 0 WebGL contexts allocated and zero rAF loops.

input.pointer: Fine pointer hover acquires a lease and ripples around the cursor; released 3 s after the pointer leaves or stops moving. If all 4 contexts are busy, the least recently used idle image gives its slot up
input.touch: Touch pointers fall back to plain static image with zero WebGL allocation
input.keyboard: The wrapper is not focusable. For linked images (wrapped in <a> or containing a covering <a>), focus on the link triggers the ripple effect and draws a two-tone inset focus ring above the canvas (never clipped by overflow:hidden parents); exactly one tab stop is preserved. Purely decorative images have no keyboard activation. The canvas is aria-hidden

a11y.notes: The underlying HTML img element keeps the full accessible name via alt; the WebGL canvas overlay and focus ring are aria-hidden. A linked image gets exactly one tab stop (the link itself). Keyboard activation is supported whether the image is wrapped in an <a> or contains a covering <a> inside its children.

props.name: src
props.effect: URL of the underlying image to display and distort.

props.name: alt
props.effect: Accessible alternative text for the image.

props.name: width
props.effect: Optional layout width defining container and image dimensions.

props.name: height
props.effect: Optional layout height defining container and image dimensions.

props.name: speed
props.effect: Frequency and wave propagation rate during interaction.

props.name: maxTier
props.effect: Hard ceiling on device capability tier (0 to 3).

props.name: crossOrigin
props.effect: CORS setting for the image. Only set to 'anonymous' when the host server sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin headers. If set on a host without CORS headers, the browser blocks the image entirely. When omitted, images from non-CORS hosts cleanly fall back to static image display without errors.

props.name: fetchPriority
props.effect: Native fetchpriority attribute forwarded to the underlying img element.

props.name: srcSet
props.effect: Native srcset. When the browser picks another candidate (resize, DPR change) the new pixels are uploaded to the texture.

props.name: imgClassName
props.effect: Class names for the inner img.

props.name: imgStyle
props.effect: Inline styles merged onto the inner img.

props.name: children
props.effect: Content layered above the image and canvas, for example a caption or a link.

mistakes: Do not set crossOrigin='anonymous' unless the host server actually sends CORS headers (Access-Control-Allow-Origin); setting it on a non-CORS host causes the browser to block the image entirely. Omit it to let DistortionImage cleanly display the static image without errors.
Do not set position: absolute on the underlying img without specifying container dimensions; let the image define layout to avoid CLS.
Do not attempt to animate strength or pointer coordinates manually with requestAnimationFrame; the component handles internal interaction loops.
verify: Confirm real img element is rendered in server HTML before hydration with zero CLS.
Confirm that when hovering with a fine pointer, a WebGL context lease is acquired and released after 3s idle.
Confirm that coarse touch pointers and reduced-motion render plain image with 0 WebGL contexts.
